[Story]
Cheng Lu and Zhang Xia are a couple in love. On the evening of February 10, Zhang Xia suddenly asks Cheng Lu with a bit of coquetry, "Do you know what day it is in a few days?"

[Question]
What does Zhang Xia most likely mean when she says these words?

[Candidate Answers]
A. She may want to know if Cheng Lu remembers her birthday.
B. She may be reminding Cheng Lu that the Lunar New Year is coming soon.
C. She may be testing whether Cheng Lu knows their anniversary.
D. She most likely wants to remind Cheng Lu not to forget to prepare a Valentine's Day gift.
